[center][/center]

[center][/center]

[center][color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Download, unzip, drop into your mods folder. Do not install with Vortex.[/b][/size][/color][/center]

Manifest.Name: Rainy Day Lamplights
Manifest.Description: Lamp posts glow warmly on rainy days, not just at night. Works with map mods and lighting mods.
